topSignals.title: Eighth consecutive quiet day — Elcogen now 20 days quiet, Topsoe 87 days.
topSignals.text: Dedicated searches for both priority stacks, this cycle's Tier 2 rotation (new cycle, round 1: Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy) and sweep, the Tier 3 rotation (cycle 11, round 4, completing the full 20-company roster: Denso, Thermax) and two further Tier 3 sweeps, and broad AI-datacenter/hyperscaler (English and German), regulation, competing-power, market/financials, research/IP and scientific-paper checks all returned only recycled/already-logged background or out-of-window items (see notes below). Nothing confirmed beat or neared any row in SOFC_Benchmark_Records.md. For Dominic: no action needed on the LCOE model today; SPP's own FERC large-load show-cause answer (due Nov 20) still has not produced analyzable trade-press coverage, now two days running. Elcogen News | Topsoe press releases

items.text: Elcogen (priority): 20 days quiet (since the Nov 2 Hygreen Energy MoU). No new item found today; search results recirculated the already-logged May 2026 elcoStack E3000 G2 mass-manufacturable platform launch (Hydrogen Central) and the Sept 2026 Metrosert testing-expansion deal (Indian Chemical News).

Topsoe (priority): 87 days quiet on SOFC/SOEC specifically (since the Aug 27 H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset). No new item found today; Topsoe's press feed remains active but non-solid-oxide (SOEC-for-PtX, e-methanol with Forestal, e-SAF with Carbon Neutral Fuels, DKK 25M grid-access funding) (Topsoe news).

Today's Tier 2 dedicated rotation (Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy — new cycle, round 1): no new item for either; results recycled Bloom's standing Oracle/AEP/Brookfield/NTT DATA backlog narrative (DCD) and FuelCell Energy's StabilityMax DOE testbed/Fit Energy/SDCL background (HPCwire).

Today's Tier 3 dedicated rotation (Denso, Thermax — cycle 11, round 4, completing the full 20-company roster): no new item for either; both companies' top headlines remain their standing Ceres Power SOEC-licensing partnerships (Denso's NEDO-backed hydrogen program; Thermax's India green-hydrogen SOEC manufacturing deal with Ceres), all pre-2026-vintage.
Competitor roster: SOFC systems for data centers

Bloom Energy: Deployed/signed at multiple named sites — Oracle/Project Jupiter, AEP/Google Cheyenne Fuel Cell LLC (702 MW/$4B, 20-yr PPA), Brookfield EaaS, Nebius (328 MW/$2.6B), Equinix (>100 MW/19 sites), Aligned "Project Phoenix" (2 GW), Hitachi (Japan), SK Eternix (28 MW, operational), NTT DATA (900 MW, global, shipments from 2027).

FuelCell Energy (incl. HyAxiom-branded products): Signed orders/PPAs — Fit Energy (up to 380 MW), Inuverse Korea (up to 100 MW), Texas CRA (75 MW), SDCL (up to 450 MW). Also hosting the DOE/national-lab-backed StabilityMax R&D testbed in Danbury, CT. No named commercial deployment live yet.
Doosan Fuel Cell/HyAxiom: Signed order — US AI data center supply contract (KRW 823.6B); supplies SOFC stacks to Reverion. No named data-center site of its own yet.
Convion: Pipeline-only/pre-commercial under HD Hyundai ownership; no named data-center customer.
SK ecoplant: Pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment.
Ceres Power's SOFC licensees (Doosan, Delta Electronics, Weichai): Licensing/pipeline-only; no named data-center deployment via Ceres licensing directly.
Reverion: Pipeline-only — Doosan-supplied SOFC stacks for rSOC power plants (Germany); no named data-center customer yet.
Petra Power: Pre-commercial, no named customer; first infrastructure deployment targeted 2028.
EGEN Energy (China, watch-list): Pre-commercial/early-stage; no named data-center customer yet.
